name: Midges
desc: Lek columns of midges dancing in the last warm light — each insect rises slowly and drops fast in the real gnat bob while darting sideways on two rates, the columns backlit by a soft dusk haze that makes the specks catch fire, the whole cluster wandering the frame over minutes.

energy.doc: agitation — how hard the swarm boils, plus halo strength

density.doc: number of columns (1-5) and insects per column

scale.doc: column + insect size vs design size

spread.doc: 0 = one tight cluster at the anchor, 1 = columns scattered wide across the frame

hue.doc: dusk light hue (38 amber, 12 sunset red, 200 cold blue evening)

style.doc: aesthetic: backlit warm motes in a golden haze / dark bodies against a pale glow, no interior / long-exposure flight arcs instead of dots / blueprint cross-hairs with velocity vectors and a bounding ellipse

act.doc: dramaturgy: columns hold station and dance / columns roam right across the frame / agitation surges and settles with the musical arc
